title: Airborne plant pathogens (illustrative starter list)
description: Fungal, oomycete and bacterial plant pathogens dispersed through the air, chosen for crops and trees in temperate regions. Detection shows DNA in the air, not infection; many have non-pathogenic relatives that are hard to separate by sequence. Taxonomy IDs were written from knowledge of NCBI Taxonomy and could not all be checked against it when the list was made; screening ignores an ID whose name in your taxonomy belongs to a different genus, and reports it under list_validation_warnings.

entries.name: Puccinia striiformis
entries.notes: Yellow (stripe) rust of wheat and barley; long-distance spore dispersal.

entries.name: Puccinia graminis
entries.notes: Stem (black) rust of wheat.

entries.name: Puccinia triticina
entries.notes: Brown (leaf) rust of wheat.

entries.name: Blumeria graminis
entries.notes: Powdery mildew of cereals and grasses.

entries.name: Zymoseptoria tritici
entries.notes: Septoria tritici blotch of wheat.

entries.name: Parastagonospora nodorum
entries.notes: Septoria nodorum blotch of wheat.

entries.name: Pyrenophora tritici-repentis
entries.notes: Tan spot of wheat.

entries.name: Pyricularia oryzae
entries.notes: Rice blast and wheat blast; a quarantine concern for wheat outside its current range.

entries.name: Fusarium graminearum
entries.notes: Fusarium head blight of cereals; mycotoxin producer.

entries.name: Fusarium culmorum
entries.notes: Fusarium head blight and foot rot; mycotoxin producer.

entries.name: Claviceps purpurea
entries.notes: Ergot of cereals and grasses; toxic alkaloids.

entries.name: Ramularia collo-cygni
entries.notes: Ramularia leaf spot of barley.

entries.name: Leptosphaeria maculans
entries.notes: Phoma stem canker of oilseed rape.

entries.name: Sclerotinia sclerotiorum
entries.notes: Sclerotinia stem rot; very broad host range.

entries.name: Botrytis cinerea
entries.notes: Grey mould of fruit, vegetables and flowers.

entries.name: Venturia inaequalis
entries.notes: Apple scab.

entries.name: Cercospora beticola
entries.notes: Cercospora leaf spot of sugar beet.

entries.name: Ustilago maydis
entries.notes: Corn smut of maize.

entries.name: Hymenoscyphus fraxineus
entries.notes: Ash dieback.

entries.name: Phytophthora infestans
entries.notes: Late blight of potato and tomato.

entries.name: Plasmopara viticola
entries.notes: Downy mildew of grapevine.

entries.name: Bremia lactucae
entries.notes: Downy mildew of lettuce.

entries.name: Pseudomonas syringae
entries.notes: Many pathovars; also common on leaves without causing disease.
